The theory of parity complexes is developed in [26] under certain assumptions on the strata of the given stratification, see [26, §2.1]. We do not claim that (and do not know if) these technical conditions are satisfied in the cases considered in Corollary 5.13, but only that the complexes $\mathrm{IC}_{\overline{\mathrm{Bun}}_{B}^{\lambda}}$ and $\mathrm{IC}_{\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}}$ satisfy the parity vanishing conditions for even or odd complexes from [26, Definition 2.4].

5.5. Cohomology of Zastava schemes with support in the central fiber

The main step towards the proof of Theorem 5.9 will be the following lemma, where we use the notation introduced in §4.10.
card.label: Remark 5.14

paper.title: Modular intersection cohomology of Drinfeld's compactifications
paper.abstract: We compute the dimension of the cohomology of stalks of intersection cohomology complexes on Zastava schemes and Drinfeld compactifications associated with a connected reductive algebraic group $G$, in case the characteristic of the coefficients field $\Bbbk$ is good for $G$. In particular, we show that these dimensions do not depend on the choice of $\Bbbk$.
